about.title: Why kids love us
about.value: We'll teach your child to speak English quickly and correctly — and understand grammar with ease!
about.text: Easy Peasy English is a cozy school in Bishkek where English feels like an adventure. Songs, games, stories and real conversations instead of boring cramming.

features.text: Every lesson is a game, so new words stick naturally.

features.text: Kids talk 70% of the lesson — no shy silence.

features.title: Grammar made simple
features.text: Rules turn into pictures, puzzles and funny stories.

features.title: Visible progress
features.text: Parents get monthly reports and see real results.

aboutPage.missionText1: We believe every child can speak English confidently. Our teachers turn lessons into adventures: we sing, play, act out stories and talk a lot.
aboutPage.missionText2: Small groups and a friendly atmosphere help even the shyest kids open up and start speaking.
